meta.name: SIM_NODE_MAP_V2
meta.description: sim -> topic/node mapping for sims_v2 (Classes 1-6). Classes 1-5 carry canonical topic keys only — the backend node corpus (backend/_cache/enhanced_nodes_index.json) has NO nodes for classes 1-5 (c6_*..c12_* prefixes only, 420 c6_* nodes). Class 6 sims carry validated c6_* node ids (source-declared SimDef.nodeIds, unioned with IDF-weighted title/topic/chapter token-overlap matches against node definitions).
meta.fixNote: 2026-09-13: nodeIds de-duplicated per SIMS_V2_QUALITY fixes - 5 class6 english enrichment sims and c6_chem_detail no longer double-claim unit/chapter nodes; each node is now claimed by exactly one sim.
